Do not credit forecast conversion until the complete opportunity history is reconciled.
Remove pooled-retention credit if design-partner and ordinary-customer terms are not comparable.
Do not release milestone capital until margin improvement ties to invoices and telemetry.
Do not fund until ownership and every waterfall scenario tie to executed terms.
Do not assign base-case value or release contingent capital without replication.

valueCreation.dependency: HX-02 ordinary-cohort definition and referenceable non-design-partner renewal evidence
valueCreation.milestone: Cohort playbooks and referenceable renewal evidence by quarter 2
valueCreation.stop_rule: Stop expansion credit if two ordinary cohorts fall below 105% NRR.
valueCreation.value: Formula: ordinary ARR × NRR gap × gross margin × 50% realization; $0.08M monthly cash and $9.06M exit-equity scenario credit

valueCreation.dependency: HX-06 synthetic randomized test plus a production replication tied to provider invoices
valueCreation.milestone: Replicate randomized log-cost effect in production before tranche test
valueCreation.risk: Provider price changes or workload mix invalidate transferred savings
valueCreation.stop_rule: Stop optimizer credit if the production replication interval crosses zero.
valueCreation.value: Formula: LTM compute cost × (1 − exp(log-point ITT)) × 65% adoption; $0.05M monthly cash and $7.73M exit-equity scenario credit

valueCreation.dependency: HX-04 complete stage-history audit and a governed CRM stage dictionary
valueCreation.milestone: Opportunity-level stage audit and forecast council by day 45
valueCreation.stop_rule: Keep the tranche withheld when stage history is incomplete or forecast error remains at or above 15%.
valueCreation.value: Avoids an illustrative shortfall-round trigger; unidentified forecast effect receives zero base-case credit
